purpose: Greg, 2026-09-22: the proper value to anchor the last trade on Friday so Frankie knows where to start at the Sunday open (the trading day 2021-10-04 opens Sunday 2021-10-03 22:00Z)
rule: the last MBO trade (action T) with ts_recv before the 21:00Z Friday halt for the roster instrument; nothing averaged, nothing derived

sunday_open_first_trade_for_reference.note: a reference row, not a derivation: Friday last 5.544 -> Sunday first 5.628; the gap is Frankie's to read, not ours to average

decode_caveat: measured (run 35679422333) with zstandard's stream_reader at its default read_across_frames=False, which stops after the FIRST zstd frame: records and trades are the first frame's if the object holds more than one frame, and the decode read the checked path rather than the checked bytes (the chat-9 ship review, 2026-09-22). The anchor at 20:59:56.64Z lies 3.4 s before the halt, so a truncated read is unlikely but unproven. frankie_box_friday_anchor.sh now decodes across frames and hashes the bytes it decodes (zstd_frames, decoded_sha256 in its receipt); a re-run on the box, on Greg's word, replaces this caveat with the measured frame count. The anchor value itself is not changed here.
